rationale: Both reviews independently caught the two most substantive GT findings (v2 codec wrongly selected for legacy checkpoints, and slot-leak-on-abort), plus the NPU dummy-run seq_token_counts gap and the WER-fallback stereo/48kHz mislabeling issue linyueqian raised. Y additionally caught the missing vendored-provenance-header concern that X missed, and grounds every claim with literal quoted code plus an explicit verified/refuted checklist (even refuting the PR's own 'fixed leak' commit claim), giving it a slight recall and rigor edge; its suggestion blocks are also more directly actionable as drop-in patches. Neither review caught the cumulative/delta chunk_np re-slice bug or the audio_tokenizer_v2 floor/ceil length bug that linyueqian flagged, so recall is capped for both. X's prose is more readable and equally well-grounded but slightly narrower in verified coverage.
